{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Eggs]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|US Cuisine]]

This is a neat to-go version of our favorite poached egg dish. 

==Ingredients==

*1 dash [[Cookbook:Vinegar|white vinegar]]
*2 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pita|pita]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
*[[Cookbook:Salmon|Smoked salmon]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] enough water to fill a deep pan.
#Add vinegar to the water.
#Crack eggs into the boiling water/vinegar mixture. Leave them alone for 5–7 minutes.
#Cut open the top of a pita. Line the inside of the pita with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
#Take eggs out of the pan using a slotted spoon and drop them into the pita.
#Eat immediately.
